summary.zh: 配置 ShellCheck 静态检查并修复告警
summary.en: Configure ShellCheck linting and resolve findings

description.zh: 说明 ShellCheck 的规则配置、抑制方式与集成位置，帮助定位脚本质量问题并兼顾可移植性。适合为项目建立 shell 检查流程或清理存量告警。需要安装 ShellCheck。
description.en: Explains ShellCheck rule configuration, suppressions and where to run it, helping fix script issues while keeping portability. Suits setting up shell linting or clearing existing warnings. Requires ShellCheck installed.
